_notes.num_training_points: Number of points sub-sampled for the GP. O(n^3) cost, so 1000-3000 is practical. More points = better accuracy but slower fitting and prediction.
_notes.gp_lr: Adam learning rate for kernel hyperparameter optimisation.
_notes.gp_num_iters: Gradient steps on the marginal log-likelihood per DOF. 300-1000 is typical.
_notes.gp_jitter: Small diagonal addition for Cholesky stability. Increase if you hit numerical issues.
_notes.max_samples: Cap on total residual samples loaded before GP sub-sampling. null = use all.
